data.name: Laya
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Laya means ‘dancer’ or ‘melody’. This name is derived from the root word ‘laya’ which means ‘to fold’. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Saraswati is often depicted as a dancer, representing the harmonious union of knowledge, music, and art. The name Laya is also associated with the concept of ‘laya’, the divine energy that permeates the universe and is the source of all creation.

data.numerology_meaning: Those with a life path number 3 are natural communicators and artistic souls. They possess a love for self-expression and creativity. Laya is a beautiful and meaningful name for a child who embodies these traits.

It is believed that the name Laya carrying the blessings of Goddess Saraswati, the embodiment of knowledge, art, and music, would aid in the development of the child's artistic, creative, and intellectual abilities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Laya refers to the divine energy or Shakti that is present in all creation. It represents the unifying power of the universe, connecting all beings to the divine. The name Laya, derived from the root word 'laya' meaning 'to fold', is also associated with the idea of surrendering oneself to the divine will, trusting that the cosmic dance of life will unfold in perfect harmony.
